_what: Word triggers that tie a job description to one of George's assets or receipts. scripts/asset_hits.py scans every gathered description with these and prints the hits per job, so the match is mechanical, not memory. Each entry: words = regexes (case-insensitive); say = the one line a letter or answer uses; proof = where it can be checked; status = where it lives as of the date. Refresh status with scripts/check_assets.py. Built 2026-10-27 from me/assets.md and me/george-dossier.md.
